scope: Four independently inspected static design references; applicability is conditional and original audio/lyrics remain unreviewed.

records.visual_basis: Forward-slanted angular title bands, dotted saturated fills, thick light outlines and central-character overlap.
image_conditions: room for cropped top/bottom type bands
busy background can be reduced in contrast behind title

possible_meanings.basis: extreme scale, saturated pattern and assertive directional letterforms
the same dense treatment can conflict deliberately with restrained or negative lyrics; requires contextual intention, not inferred original meaning

music_conditions: high-energy arrival or emphatic hold if verified in the new song
avoid assigning exact beat positions from this still
records.use_when: A short lyric or title can carry the moment through a few recognizable letter silhouettes while the performer remains central.
avoid_when: quiet literal narration unless deliberate contrast is intended
subject position changes unpredictably without a protected region
records.variation_changes_meaning: More cropping, stronger pattern and shorter dwell increase visual pressure; a larger clear gap and longer hold make the same vocabulary more welcoming. These are design hypotheses to test.
records.neighboring_shots: A quieter preceding layout can make the title arrival legible. Retain a chosen motif or color relationship into the next shot; continuous camera or shape motion needs separate boundary checks.
records.validation_example: Replace the short Latin title with a short Han phrase and a longer phrase. Check exposed glyph structure, subject visibility and small-screen reading; do not assume identical spacing works.

source_context.context_limit: Visual interpretation and proposed usage, not a claim about original lyric meaning, beat synchronization or author intent.

records.override_policy: External authors may revise every condition; these are interpretable recommendations, not a closed effect selector.

records.visual_basis: Smaller light outlined serif word over a much larger dark serif duplicate, both on black.
image_conditions: sufficient value separation between duplicate and primary outline

possible_meanings.basis: one word appears at two scales and visibility levels
restrained palette, empty space and serif structure
a large dark duplicate can feel intrusive when paired with tense lyrical/visual context

music_conditions: held note or pause after a short phrase
may serve a quiet or tense passage; not automatically a sad-song effect
records.use_when: The text itself should remain a focal object and the second layer has a semantic reason to repeat it.
avoid_when: rapid dense syllables that leave no time to read outlines
busy footage with similar gray edges
default duplication on every line without narrative function
records.variation_changes_meaning: Distance, scale ratio, outline weight and duplicate contrast change whether the second layer feels like an echo, a shadow or an equal second voice.
records.neighboring_shots: Preserve the readable foreground word through entry; a subsequent line/point exit is a separate motion proposal requiring native-frame evidence.
records.validation_example: Use a single held word, then a multiword sentence. Check whether serif details remain readable and whether the duplicate actually supports the intended semantic role.

source_context.context_limit: Visual interpretation and proposed usage, not a claim about original lyric meaning, beat synchronization or author intent.

records.override_policy: External authors may revise every condition; these are interpretable recommendations, not a closed effect selector.

records.visual_basis: Repeated slanted composite cards containing heavy Japanese letters, double borders, small box icons and faint offset outlines.
image_conditions: foreground subject absent or explicitly protected
panel borders remain distinct from letter outlines

possible_meanings.basis: repetition removes empty space and makes one message ubiquitous
orderly card repetition and a bright palette can suggest comic or pop design rather than pressure

music_conditions: repeated short vocal rhythm or designed visual escalation
sparse release afterward can contrast with density; source beat relation remains unknown
records.use_when: Repetition is meaningful to the lyric or sequence and a brief loss of spaciousness is intentional.
avoid_when: nuanced unique lines that must all be read
dense character footage without compositing separation
long continuous use that erases contrast between song sections
records.variation_changes_meaning: Regular spacing and aligned borders suggest order; varied scale, occlusion and irregular replacement create tension. Palette alone does not determine emotion.
records.neighboring_shots: Transition to a sparse group can create release. If the words differ, model it as replacement/cut or a specified correspondence, not an assumed morph of identical glyphs.
records.validation_example: Compare one repeated hook with a paragraph of unique lyrics. Confirm the former can function as a texture without losing its semantic anchor and the latter is not forced into an unreadable wall.

source_context.context_limit: Visual interpretation and proposed usage, not a claim about original lyric meaning, beat synchronization or author intent.

records.visual_basis: Large stepped pixel letter faces with bright fill, warm keyline and a dark offset block-shadow appearance over duplicated character imagery.
image_conditions: letter face and shadow separate from background highlights
digital or interface motifs can support the association but are not mandatory

possible_meanings.reading: digital mediation, retro-game or interface address
possible_meanings.basis: visible stepped construction and block shading resemble low-resolution display conventions
bright face, large size and dimensional separation assert a focal headline
cheerful display vocabulary against contradictory lyric/image context can create dissonance; must be chosen deliberately

music_conditions: short emphatic statement or an intentional refrain identity
not a generic choice for every energetic line
records.use_when: A compact phrase benefits from being treated as a displayed message or graphic identity.
avoid_when: subtle intimate narration unless the mediated contrast is wanted
small low-resolution output where separate pixel steps blur together
several competing equally bright headline layers
records.variation_changes_meaning: Regular pixel modules and stable shadow suggest a coherent display; broken registration or unstable repetition can produce instability, but must not sacrifice the key message unintentionally.
records.neighboring_shots: Carry a pixel unit, keyline or UI motif between shots instead of requiring all objects to share a camera. Avoid making all neighboring text equally dominant.
records.validation_example: Render a short word and a mixed-script phrase at target and reduced sizes. Inspect step rhythm, shadow offset, counters and visual hierarchy without reusing original artwork.
